items.title: SAP Security Update – Patch for Critical Vulnerabilities Allowing Code Execution and Injection Attacks
items.description: SAP released its monthly Security Patch Day updates, addressing 18 new security notes and providing two updates to existing ones, focusing on vulnerabilities that could enable remote code execution and various injection attacks across its product ecosystem. items.title: Hackers Exploiting Triofox 0-Day Vulnerability to Execute Malicious Payload Abusing Anti-Virus Feature
items.description: Google Mandiant has disclosed active exploitation of CVE-2025-12480, a critical unauthenticated access vulnerability in Gladinet’s Triofox file-sharing platform. The threat cluster tracked as UNC6485 has been weaponizing this flaw since August 2025 to gain unauthorized administrative access and establish persistent remote control over compromised systems. items.title: CISA Warns of Samsung Mobile Devices 0-Day RCE Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: CISA has added a critical zero-day vulnerability affecting Samsung mobile devices to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Warning that threat actors are actively exploiting the flaw in real-world attacks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-21042, is an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the libimagecodec.quram.so library on Samsung mobile devices. This security flaw allows remote…

items.title: Threat Actors Leverage RMM Tools to Deploy Medusa & DragonForce Ransomware
items.description: A sophisticated wave of ransomware attacks targeting UK organizations has emerged in 2025, exploiting vulnerabilities in the widely-used SimpleHelp Remote Monitoring and Management platform. items.title: OWASP Highlights Supply Chain Risks in New Top 10 List
items.description: Security misconfiguration jumped to second place while injection vulnerabilities dropped, as organizations improve defenses against traditional coding flaws.
